about.en: CVXon is the Ondo tokenized stock for Chevron Corporation (NYSE: CVX), issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited through the Ondo Stocks platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is backed by CVX shares and is a total-return tracker: dividends are reinvested net of withholding tax, so one token can come to represent more than one share. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum at 0x8F3E41b378ae010c46d255F36bFC1D303b52dceb, with deployments on BNB Chain and Solana. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership or shareholder rights.
